description: A front flat on the second floor, two windows onto Filament Street and the streetlight directly outside one of them, which is either a feature or the reason the last tenant left. The floor slopes toward the front wall by an amount you stop noticing in about a week.

window.description: Two sash windows onto Filament Street, the nearer one washed in flat orange all night from the lamp outside.
window.name: the street windows
